name: Eien no Ikusa Hime
source: Eien no Ikusa Hime contains the novelized versions of Ikusa Megami Zero, Genrin no Kishougun and Genrin no Kishougun 2 for those who want to jump into Verita without missing the previous story developments.
translation: 《永焰的战姬》收录《战女神ZERO》《幻燐的姬将军》与《幻燐的姬将军2》的小说版，方便想直接游玩《战女神VERITA》、又不愿错过此前剧情的玩家。
